title: complete-session next_command respects first_qa residual
summary: complete_adoption_session no longer jumps to feed when core_ready but first_qa unseeded; routes to first-qa-plan. no_session/already_completed expose next_command. Epic #1000 adopter TTV.
migration_impact: Additive routing. Agents completing adopt sessions should follow next_command (first-qa-plan before feed when unseeded).
agent_notes: After gh plate adopt --complete-session --json, if first_qa_seeded=false run next_command (first-qa-plan) before feed. Parent Epic #1000.
